title: Micropatterning on glass with deep UV
protocol: Wash glass coverslips in Ethanol 70% for 1 minute.
Dry coverslips with absorbent paper.
Illuminate coverslips with deep UV lamp for 5 minutes at a distance of 5 cm from the lamp.
Place a drop of 50 to 200 μl PLL-g-PEG solution on parafilm and place the coverslip on top, activated face in contact with PEG.
Incubate the setup for 1 hour at room temperature in a humid chamber.
Wash the coverslip for 2 minutes in PBS.
Rinse the coverslip twice for 2 minutes each in H2O.
Wear gloves.
Clean mask with 70% Ethanol using a soft tissue.
Put quartz mask with metal side facing UV lamp.
Illuminate mask surface for 5 minutes to clean and make it hydrophilic.
Place 3 μl of Millipore water on the metal side of the mask.
Position coverslip with pegylated side on the water drop.
Press coverslip against mask using a plastic tip, removing excess water.
Illuminate quartz side of the mask for 3 to 10 minutes with UV lamp.
Illuminate the coverlip for 3 min for RPE-1 cells or 5 min for HeLa cells.
Place 5 mL of water on the coverlip and leave until it spontaneously floats.
Carefully remove the coverlip to avoid scratching the mask with tweezers.
Incubate the illuminated surface at room temperature for 1 hour with a fibronectin solution (25 µg/mL in 100 mM NaHCO3, pH 8.5).
Add 5 μg/mL of labeled fibrinogen or fibronectin to visualize patterns.
Collect cells using EDTA 0.02% in PBS and not trypsin.
Rinse the EDTA solution with pre-warmed and pH equilibrated culture medium.
Resuspend the cells well using a 1 mL micropipette.
Add 100,000 to 200,000 cells for a 25 mm coverslip or 6 well plate well.
Use a small volume of solution (e.g., 500 μL) for the dish.
Leave the dish in the incubator without moving it.
Wash unattached cells 20-30 min after plating with equilibrated hot medium.
Add medium from one side to create a gentle flow over cells when washing.
Aspirate medium from the other side simultaneously during washing.
Cells should be spread on the patterns 1 hour after plating.
